authorship: Assistant-authored synthetic cases; manual non-blinded review, no independent gold reviewer.
criteria: Every saved skip stays skipped; no save-failure speculation or repeated question.
Select a supported project and draft ordinary required documents without asking the user to choose content or approve drafting. Preserve the original resume and unsupported skipped claims.
For login, save required public-JD document and retain it on the role review. Practical concise login handoff, without navigation or form visibility narration.
For accessible form, populate known facts, finished written answer and file mappings. Leave unselected consent blank.
If portfolio original is missing, ask for an existing authentic file while completing ordinary materials and known fields. Never fabricate portfolio/credentials.
Actual tool result supplied to the provider is dedicated readable text; no external submission.
The skipped Delta Voice proposed addition stays out of both resume and supporting document, even though it appears in imported profile context; existing source-supported work remains usable.
limits: Three synthetic diagnostic cases, no general success-rate claim or ATS submission test.
